page.overview:
Who is Hisa?

Hisa is a short, old woman with wrinkled skin and thick eyebrows. Her bulky, gray hair is tied into a medium sized bun with two strands poking out behind her ears.

In most of her appearances, Hisa is seen wearing a plain maroon kimono with a purple obi. She also wears a pair of black zōri sandals with white tabi socks.

Hisa comes off as a very kind and welcoming person, bringing in the injured Demon Slayers without hesitation and providing them with commodities for recovery. Despite Inosuke Hashibira's impolite nature, she proved to be very patient with him and doesn't appear to be affected by his remarks.

Inosuke noted that even with his enhanced perception, Hisa's kind demeanor made it impossible for him to detect her presence because she bore no ounce of ill-will towards him.
